english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting something away while it is not in use.
Use this when removing items from display, circulation, or availability by putting them away.

examples.english: I store the camera when I’m not using it.
examples.traditional: 我唔用部相機嗰陣會收起。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jung6 bou6 soeng2 gei1 go2 zan6 wui5 sau1 hei2

examples.english: This toy is no longer for sale, so pull it from the shelves.
examples.traditional: 呢款玩具唔再賣喇，收起晒。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fun2 waan2 geoi6 m4 zoi3 maai6 laa3 sau1 hei2 saai3
